title: Tonight, they’re on air.
lead: A radio broadcast hosted by their AI clone. Send a comment and they may read it on air and answer. Cheer them on with gifts and Super Chat.
fill: They read your comment, answer, and carry on.
requestTitle: Pick a theme. Request a broadcast in their voice.
requestBody: The AI writes the rundown and their AI clone keeps talking, so there’s no dead air. Requests use a radio ticket, and first-timers get a trial.
archiveBody: Finished shows keep their recording, so you can listen back.
footnote: Radio broadcasts are audio-only, AI-generated content. Whether requests are open depends on the creator. If a broadcast can’t start, your ticket is returned.
stageAlt: Illustration of a radio broadcast with comments scrolling and a Super Chat marked as read on air.
